questions.stem: What is potential difference defined as?

options.text: The total energy stored in a battery
The rate of flow of charge through a circuit
The energy transferred per unit charge between two points

questions.explanation: Potential difference (voltage) is defined as the energy transferred per unit charge between two points in a circuit. It is measured in volts (V), where 1 V = 1 J/C (one joule per coulomb).
